source_title: 'OM' director Rajkumar Periasamy reacts to Dhanush's political entry buzz
source_excerpt: Actor Dhanush has been in the news because of his upcoming movies as well as his political plans. Even though he is still occupied with several movies, his recent activities have raised questions regarding whether he would go into politics in the coming days. Moreover, his fan clubs have also become more active, which further increases the talk about what his next step will be. But Dhanush has not yet officially announced about forming a political party. The latest to share his thoughts on the topic is director Rajkumar Periasamy, who has worked with the actor in his upcoming film.Rajkumar Periasamy reacts to Dhanush's political entry speculationDuring a recent interview with Cinema Vikatan, Rajkumar Periasamy was asked about the ongoing buzz surrounding Dhanush's possible political entry. Sharing his view, Rajkumar Periasamy said, "Dhanush is deeply passionate about cinema, and considering the number of films he has lined up, I find it difficult to imagine him moving into politics. From what I have seen, Dhanush is someone who is deeply passionate about cinema. He is making films at a very fast pace. Even before his 55th film releases, the pooja for his 56th film has already taken place. His 57th, 58th, 59th, and 60th films have also been planned." He further pointed out that the actor has several projects lined up and continues to focus on his film career.Dhanush's political activities and fan club developmentsSpeculation about Dhanush's political plans gained attention after he met members of his fan club in Tiruvallur on his birthday. He later reportedly transformed his fan clubs into an organised movement and introduced a new flag. More recently, he also met women office-bearers associated with his organisation. There have been reports about efforts to register a political party, but Dhanush is yet to confirm any such plans. His organisation has also reportedly discussed setting up air-conditioned tuition centres for students across all 234 constituencies in Tamil Nadu.Dhanush's upcoming films and Rajkumar Periasamy's 'OM'Meanwhile, Dhanush continues to have a busy film schedule. His upcoming film 'OM,' directed by Rajkumar Periasamy, is set to release in theatres on November 20. The film also stars Mammootty and Sai Pallavi in important roles. After this project, the actor has films lined up with directors including Tamizharasan Pachamuthu, Mari Selvaraj, and Vetrimaaran.
